create_bed_parser: create a BED file parser using the Bed class to load and access genomic interval records
parse_bed_file: parse a BED format file into a list of BedRecord objects with chromosome, start, end, name, and score fields
get_bed_records: get a list of BedRecord objects from a parsed BED file via the Bed.records property
calculate_bed_record_size: calculate the size of a BED record interval using the BedRecord.size property
build_bed_record: build a BedRecord dataclass instance with chromosome, start, end, optional name, and optional score
